test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question: **Telangana’s contribution to the national stock of paddy is:**

options.text: one-third of the country’s procurement target
more than half of the country’s paddy procurement
less than half of the nation’s rice procurement
half of the nation’s procurement target

solution:
The correct answer is: **more than half of the country’s paddy procurement**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The second sentence of the first paragraph in the given passage states, *"The Food Corporation of India (FCI) has procured 52 lakh tonnes of paddy from Telangana alone, which is more than half of the national target of 91 lakh tonnes."*
 
• From here we can say that Telangana’s contribution to the national stock of paddy is more than half of the country’s paddy procurement.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.
